title: Asiad: PH's Jericho Francisco misses skateboarding podium
summary: The Philippines just missed out on another bronze in the 2026 Asian Games, with Jericho Francisco placing fourth in men's park in skateboarding on Friday at the Aichi Sky Expo Hall.
